correctness.reason: The load-bearing fibre calculation was independently reconstructed from the stated quotient ring rather than accepted from the stored success log. For f=-2-t+2t^3 and g=2+t^2 in Q[t]/(t^8-1), the four vectors g^2, t g^2, t^2 g^2, t^3 g^2 have rank four. Annihilating h^2 f modulo that subspace yields four quadrics. In the b0=1 chart their Groebner basis is b1, b2-1/2, b3; each chart on b0=0 has Groebner basis containing 1. The Jacobian at [2:0:1:0] has projective rank three, so the fibre is a single reduced point. The standard finite-morphism/Nakayama argument then forces generic tangent degree one. For a (2,2,2,2) threefold, c(TX)=1+4H^2-8H^3 and H^3=16, so the Chern tangent identity gives degree 64 when the tangent degree is one.
